lead_fa: Guardian یک تانک فرم‌عوض‌کن با کاهش آسیب پسیو قوی و Ironfur بدون کول‌داون است؛ چرخه‌اش از ساده‌ترین چرخه‌های کل بازی است. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Druid of the Claw]] با تمرکز روی خونریزی‌های بزرگ و کمی جلوتر در DPS تک‌هدف، و [[Elune's Chosen]] که [[Lunar Beam]] را به دکمهٔ تهاجمی-دفاعی اصلی تبدیل می‌کند.

strengths: Strong passive damage reduction, baseline and talented
Powerful active physical mitigation through stackable, no-cooldown Ironfur with 100% uptime
Defensives with short cooldowns make damage intake consistent and stable
Raid utility options: Stampeding Roar, Convoke the Spirits, After the Wildfire, Dream of Cenarius
Excels in high physical damage encounters, especially ramping/spike damage, due to Rage gain from Bristling Fur/Blood Frenzy
weaknesses: Lack of great crowd control options in the spec tree
Hard to grab initial threat since much of your damage is DoT-based
No unique niche or tank utility

season2_changes: Lunation now reduces Lunar Beam's cooldown by a flat 20s (removes the Moonfire spam playstyle of Season 1)
Innervate now causes the healer to regenerate 20% max mana over 8s (replaces free casts)
Gory Fur now grants Ironfur a chance to make your next Maul/Raze/Ravage free, and vice versa
Wild Guardian apex rework: 10% chance on Thrash or Mangle to summon a spirit for 8s; when awakened, Thrash/Mangle cooldowns reset and deal 30% more damage while active

hero.recommendation: Both trees are fairly even defensively; Druid of the Claw pulls ahead slightly in single-target DPS. Elune's Chosen is simpler and carries the (Best) tags in current tables.
hero.druid_of_the_claw: Guardian-Feral synergy focused on big Bleed effects; slightly ahead in single-target DPS.
hero.elunes_chosen: Astral focus revolving around Lunar Beam and Moonfire; simpler tree that barely affects rotation; Lunar Beam becomes a core offensive-defensive button granting large Mastery on a short cooldown.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Guardian Druid Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/druid/guardian/talent-builds-pve-tank), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Avoid Rage waste: Ironfur spends Rage off-GCD; Ursoc's Guidance reduces your biggest cooldown's downtime based on Rage spent.
Keep abilities on cooldown: keep Mangle and Thrash rolling to maximize Rage generation and damage.
Maul too often is a significant DPS loss with the new Spirit's Wrath apex talent (low damage, risks losing Mangle/Thrash casts).

st_druid_of_the_claw: Maintain Moonfire on your primary target
Spend Rage on Maul (offensively) or Ironfur (defensively)
Frenzied Regeneration if your health dips low
Use Barkskin / Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc as frequently as possible
Swipe if nothing else to press
rotation.rage_rules: With Harnessed Rage, stay above 80 Rage before each Maul cast. Without it, spend most Rage on Ironfur to fish for Apex procs without hindering your GCD. Avoid wasting GCDs on Swipe (no Rage, little damage).
rotation.opener: The opener matches the single-target priority: Red Moon, Mangle and Thrash on cooldown, keep 3-5 Thrash stacks, spend Rage on Maul after Incarnation (to proc Apex) or Ironfur defensively, Frenzied Regeneration on dips, and Barkskin/Incarnation as often as possible.
rotation.cooldowns: Berserk/Incarnation, Lunar Beam, Heart of the Wild, Survival Instincts, Barkskin: time or pair them only if you will not lose uses; otherwise press on cooldown. During Incarnation, maximize Thrash and Mangle casts while spending Rage on Maul/Raze/Ironfur to avoid capping.

gear.gearing_rules: Haste > Versatility > Mastery = Critical Strike; all four secondaries are quite even. Agility/ilvl upgrades almost always win. Prioritize high Haste pieces, an early weapon, and completing the tier set. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Bark of the Enigmatic Dreamwatcher
tier_set.pc2: Thrash has a 20% chance to make your next Mangle deal 100% increased damage.
tier_set.pc4: Thrash calls up 3 thorns, each impaling a target for Nature damage and dealing additional Nature damage to up to 5 nearby enemies, and extends Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc by 0.5 sec up to 5.0 sec.
tier_set.note: Fairly powerful but entirely passive: playing your normal rotation maximizes it.

catalyst: Breeches of the Sacred Hall (King's Rest)

notes: All four secondaries are quite even in strength; Haste leads for gameplay feel.
A substantial item level increase is almost always worth more than slightly better stats.

consumables.combat_potion: Draught of Rampant Abandon or Light's Potential

enchants.head: Enchant Helm - Empowered Blessing of Speed
enchants.chest: Enchant Chest - Mark of the Worldsoul

mplus.hero_note: Elune's Chosen carries the Best tags in M+; Druid of the Claw is a close alternative.
tips: Thrash on cooldown in packs (3-5 stacks) plus Swipe fills; your AoE threat is DoT-driven, so lead pulls with burst cooldowns.
Stampeding Roar is premium group utility on skips and forced movement weeks.
Bristling Fur/Blood Frenzy give big Rage during spike windows; save Ironfur stacks for them.
